columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Execution state must wait for actual agent-process readiness
columns.title_zh: 执行状态必须等待 Agent 进程真实就绪
columns.source_zh: Claude Code v2.1.247 官方发布说明
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260827-004 with Skill 02 score 46/50. A self-hosted runner that reports Running before the agent process actually starts can cause downstream clients to act on a non-existent execution worker. Waiting for real process readiness creates a precise boundary between scheduling intent, executable readiness and externally visible runtime truth.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260827-004，Skill 02 评分 46/50。若自托管 Runner 在 Agent 进程真实启动前就报告 Running，下游客户端可能基于并不存在的执行 Worker 采取动作。只有等待真实进程就绪，才能把调度意图、可执行就绪状态与对外 Runtime 真值清晰分开。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify exactly which readiness signal gates Running, how premature status affected downstream behavior, how startup failure is represented, and what regression evidence exists. Keep conclusions bounded to the demonstrated runner/process contract rather than generalizing all orchestration systems.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验究竟由什么就绪信号门控 Running、提前状态如何影响下游行为、启动失败如何表达以及有哪些回归证据；结论应限定在已展示的 Runner/Process 合同，不得泛化为所有编排系统。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Verified account access context must be host-owned and capability-scoped
columns.title_zh: 经验证的账户访问上下文必须由宿主持有并按能力范围注入
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260827-008 with Skill 02 score 46/50. The host owns account-bound entitlement context, bounds retrieval by timeout, attaches it only to narrowly eligible local read-only plugin MCP calls, and rejects caller-supplied context. This exposes a concrete architecture boundary for credential-derived authority: trusted identity context should be produced by the authority-owning host and injected only at an explicitly qualified capability edge.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260827-008，Skill 02 评分 46/50。账户绑定的 Entitlement Context 由宿主持有、读取受超时约束，只注入严格符合条件的本地只读 Plugin MCP 调用，并拒绝调用方自带上下文。该机制形成了清晰的凭据派生权限架构边界：可信身份上下文应由权限所有者宿主生成，并仅在明确合格的能力边缘注入。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify how account context is obtained and validated, the exact eligibility predicate for plugin MCP calls, timeout/failure behavior, caller-context rejection, and tests proving no propagation to ineligible calls. Do not treat this implementation as universal proof for all MCP identity designs.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验账户上下文的获取与验证方式、Plugin MCP 调用的精确准入条件、超时/失败行为、调用方上下文拒绝路径，以及证明上下文不会传播到不合格调用的测试；不得把该实现当作所有 MCP 身份设计的普遍证明。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Skill invocation can authorize only when provenance resolves under verified trusted roots
columns.title_zh: Skill 调用只有在来源解析到经验证可信根目录时才能形成授权证据
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260827-007 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Guardian records explicit and implicit user-skill invocation but accepts authorization evidence only from canonical verified paths under trusted user roots; repository skills and escaping symlinks remain untrusted. The mechanism is a testable engineering rule for turning extension provenance into a security decision without trusting path labels or invocation claims alone.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260827-007，Skill 02 评分 46/50。Guardian 会记录显式与隐式 User Skill 调用，但只有位于可信用户根目录、经过规范化与验证的路径才能形成授权证据；仓库 Skill 与逃逸符号链接仍保持不可信。该机制提供了一条可测试的工程规则：扩展来源可以参与安全决策，但不能只相信路径标签或调用声明本身。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify trusted-root resolution, canonicalization and symlink escape handling, how explicit versus implicit invocation is recorded, where the authorization evidence is consumed, and negative tests for repository or escaped skills. Keep the conclusion bounded to the demonstrated Guardian/skill contract.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验可信根目录解析、路径规范化与符号链接逃逸处理、显式/隐式调用如何记录、授权证据在哪里被消费，以及仓库 Skill/逃逸 Skill 的负向测试；结论须限定于已展示的 Guardian/Skill 合同。
